name: Shopify Stores
riskContext: A storefront can expose users to barriers across theme, app and hosted checkout boundaries.
remediationChecklist: Announce cart updates in a status region
Name each swatch and test selection through checkout
verificationScenario: Add two variants, change quantities in the cart drawer and complete checkout. Check that focus follows the drawer and that a screen reader announces the updated quantity, subtotal and any unavailability.

name: WordPress Sites
riskContext: Theme and plugin updates can reintroduce barriers to publishing and contact workflows.
remediationChecklist: Audit the active theme after updates
Associate plugin fields with visible labels and test error recovery
verificationScenario: Open a long article and use its skip link to bypass the header. Open and close the mobile menu, then submit the contact form with an invalid field and confirm focus and error feedback.

name: Dental Clinics
riskContext: Appointment access and pre-visit instructions can be blocked by third-party patient tools.
remediationChecklist: Provide keyboard date entry
Publish intake instructions as structured HTML
verificationScenario: Book a new-patient cleaning using only the keyboard. Confirm you can choose a preferred appointment, read the insurance requirements and receive a confirmation with the correct date.

name: Law Firms
riskContext: An inaccessible consultation form can block a prospective client from requesting services.
commonFailures: Required fields signaled only by color
Practice-area menus that open only on hover
remediationChecklist: Identify required fields in text
Make all practice areas reachable with keyboard navigation
verificationScenario: Navigate from a practice area to the consultation form. Trigger a required-field error and verify that the field name, reason and next action are available before sharing any personal details.

name: Real Estate Agencies
riskContext: Listing discovery and requests for showings may depend on embedded listing software.
remediationChecklist: Offer equivalent filterable listing cards
Add keyboard navigation and a pause control
verificationScenario: Filter for a property with step-free access and request a showing from the results list. Make sure opening and closing a property gallery returns focus to the listing you came from.

name: Restaurants & Ordering
riskContext: Menus and orders can be inaccessible even when a homepage is usable.
remediationChecklist: Publish prices and allergens in HTML
Restore focus after customizations and test the full order path
verificationScenario: Order a meal with an allergy-related modification using only the keyboard. Confirm that the menu exposes allergen information and that changing the order communicates the new price and selection.

name: Medical Practices
riskContext: Access to appointments and preparation materials can implicate healthcare accessibility duties.
remediationChecklist: Give every insurance input a visible label
Publish accessible prep instructions and test referrals and booking
verificationScenario: Find a provider, choose a new-patient visit and retrieve preparation instructions without using a pointer. Check the affiliated scheduling portal and instructions for matching provider and appointment details.

name: SaaS & B2B Sites
riskContext: Common barriers can prevent users from evaluating a product or participating in a demo.
remediationChecklist: Caption recorded demos
Associate errors with inputs and test confirmation announcements
verificationScenario: Find a feature comparison, play a demonstration with captions and request a demo. Submit an invalid business email and confirm the error is announced and the other fields retain their values.

name: Higher Ed & Municipal Portals
riskContext: Public institutions should assess Title II coverage and the applicable DOJ deadline; private institutions may have other accessibility obligations.
remediationChecklist: Replace active scanned documents with accessible equivalents
Test admissions or resident transactions end to end
verificationScenario: Locate application deadlines or public service hours, then complete a registration step with a screen reader. Check that any linked policy document and the vendor-hosted registration screens are usable.

name: Public Libraries
riskContext: Catalog and hold workflows affect access to publicly offered services.
remediationChecklist: Expose filter state programmatically
Name the hold dialog and verify focus returns to the title
verificationScenario: Search for a large-print book, filter by branch and place a hold. Verify the branch name and hold status in the confirmation and confirm that canceling the hold returns focus to the correct result.

name: City Government Websites
riskContext: Municipal services subject to Title II can span both agency pages and vendor tools.
remediationChecklist: Publish accessible agendas and packets
Include permit vendors in keyboard and document reviews
verificationScenario: Start a residential permit application, attach a document and find a related council agenda. Check the upload status, text alternatives for required plans and agenda reading order.

name: County Government Websites
riskContext: Residents need accessible access to records and tax services administered by counties.
commonFailures: Property searches with unlabeled date ranges
PDF tax notices without reading order
remediationChecklist: Name both ends of date ranges
Check tagged notices against the original reading order
verificationScenario: Search for an assessment by parcel or street address and open the current notice. Verify that field errors identify the input and that the notice names each tax item alongside its amount.

name: Public Transit Agencies
riskContext: Riders need accessible route planning and comparable disruption information.
commonFailures: Live delays that screen readers miss
remediationChecklist: Publish route names and stop sequences in text
Announce delay updates without stealing focus
verificationScenario: Plan an accessible trip with a transfer and locate service disruptions on the route. Cross-check that the text directions include departure times and temporary stop changes shown on the map.

name: Airline Ticketing Sites
riskContext: Passenger reservation and flight changes can involve aviation-specific accessibility duties.
commonFailures: Seat maps with no keyboard operation
remediationChecklist: Provide accessible seat selection controls
Announce revised fare totals and test rebooking
verificationScenario: Select a fare, choose an available seat with a keyboard and verify the new price. Then make a date change and confirm the difference, fees and total are communicated before submission.

name: Hotel Booking Websites
riskContext: Reservation flows can obscure accessible room features and availability.
commonFailures: Accessibility details available only as icons
remediationChecklist: List accessible features in text
Test filtering and booking an accessible room
verificationScenario: Filter for a mobility-accessible room and confirm specific features on the room detail and booking summary. Test that the calendar, accessibility filters and reservation details work with a screen reader.

name: Vacation Rental Marketplaces
riskContext: Guests may need property access details before they can make a booking decision.
remediationChecklist: Provide a structured list for property searches
Label gallery controls and describe relevant access features
verificationScenario: Find a rental with a step-free entry. Compare the listing text and images for consistent access information and check that closing the photo viewer returns focus to the originating thumbnail.

name: Banks & Credit Unions
riskContext: Customers may be blocked from managing accounts or verifying transactions.
remediationChecklist: Use a labeled code field with paste support
Verify account statements with a screen reader
verificationScenario: Sign into a test account, paste a verification code and download a recent statement. Check error recovery when the code expires and verify that transaction dates and amounts read together.

name: Insurance Agencies
riskContext: Applicants can lose access to quoting or claims if vendor steps are inaccessible.
commonFailures: File upload errors with no text
remediationChecklist: Add named progress steps
Announce accepted formats and upload failures next to the control
verificationScenario: Start a claim, upload an unsupported file and replace it with a supported document. Check that the upload constraints are available before selection and the success message identifies the accepted file.

name: Mortgage Lenders
riskContext: Borrowers need usable disclosures and document submission during time-sensitive applications.
remediationChecklist: Offer accessible timeout extension
Check disclosure semantics and document upload by keyboard
verificationScenario: Pause a test loan application until its inactivity warning appears. Extend the session with the keyboard, upload a disclosure and confirm that reviewing a document leaves the application data intact.

name: Grocery Delivery Services
riskContext: Grocery customers can face barriers when choosing substitutions or completing checkout.
commonFailures: Substitution controls with no selected state
remediationChecklist: Name quantity buttons with the item context
Expose selected substitutions and announce total changes
verificationScenario: Add several items, change one quantity and choose a substitute. Confirm that every control identifies its product and that the live total reflects each meaningful change without repetitive announcements.

name: Pharmacies
riskContext: Prescription services can be unavailable to users who cannot access refill or pickup flows.
remediationChecklist: Publish dosage instructions as readable text
Associate refill hints and errors with their fields
verificationScenario: Request a test refill, select pickup and correct an invalid prescription number. Verify that instructions remain available and the confirmation clearly identifies the selected location and estimated time.

name: Fitness Centers
riskContext: Members may be unable to review or purchase classes if scheduling tools are inaccessible.
commonFailures: Class calendars navigable only by pointer
remediationChecklist: Offer a keyboard-operable class list
Caption orientation videos and describe key demonstrations
verificationScenario: Find a beginner class with automated recurring membership disabled. Confirm that schedule information can be read without using the calendar grid and that the booking receipt states the selected time.

name: Museums & Galleries
riskContext: Opening hours, exhibit materials and ticketing need accessible paths for prospective visitors.
remediationChecklist: Supply equivalent exhibit text
Announce changes to ticket availability
verificationScenario: Locate an exhibition and book a ticket. Check that exhibition labels convey key content, ticket availability updates are announced and the order summary reflects access accommodations.

name: Theaters & Event Venues
riskContext: Patrons may lose access to ticket inventory and seating options.
remediationChecklist: Provide keyboard-operable seat listings
Name seat features and availability in text
verificationScenario: Select accessible seating with a companion seat. Verify that seat type, availability and price are perceivable in the list and that the order summary confirms both seating choices.

name: Online Education Platforms
riskContext: Inaccessible coursework can prevent meaningful participation in learning.
remediationChecklist: Provide keyboard interaction for assessment tasks
Review synchronized captions and course completion
verificationScenario: Complete a sample lesson and quiz by keyboard, including any matching question. Check the equivalent interaction, captions and whether the completion message is announced at the end.

name: Childcare Providers
riskContext: Families can be blocked from enrollment and fee information before making contact.
remediationChecklist: Label enrollment fields and provide an accessible submission path
Publish tuition schedules as text
verificationScenario: Find the tuition schedule for a specific age group and start an enrollment application. Check that the forms are operable at high zoom and that submission errors identify each affected field.

name: Automotive Dealerships
riskContext: Shoppers need access to inventory and service scheduling across dealer widgets.
commonFailures: Inventory updates requiring a page reload
remediationChecklist: Offer a labeled numeric financing input
Announce inventory changes without shifting focus
verificationScenario: Filter inventory for a particular model then schedule a service visit. Verify filter changes are announced and keyboard users can change the financing estimate by entering a numeric value.

name: Home Services Contractors
riskContext: Inaccessible request forms can block users seeking time-sensitive repairs.
commonFailures: Contact options expressed with icon-only links
remediationChecklist: Style focus on quote fields
Give phone and messaging links descriptive text
verificationScenario: Request an urgent quote without using a pointer. Verify that the emergency contact link identifies the business, the quote form shows keyboard focus and the confirmation lists an expected response time.

name: Utility Provider Portals
riskContext: Customers must be able to read outage information and manage essential accounts.
commonFailures: Bill payment errors only shown at the top
remediationChecklist: Publish searchable outage summaries
Link payment error summaries to their fields
verificationScenario: Look up an outage by street address, then try paying a test bill with a missing required field. Confirm the outage location is available in text and the error jumps to the correct field.

name: Food Banks & Nonprofits
riskContext: People seeking assistance need usable access to eligibility information and pickup locations.
commonFailures: Eligibility content distributed only in image flyers
remediationChecklist: Publish eligibility as HTML
List pickup hours and locations in text
verificationScenario: Find a pickup site and determine eligibility on a narrow screen. Check that address, hours and required documents are available together in text and readable in the same order with a screen reader.

name: Shopware Stores
riskContext: Theme components and extensions can introduce barriers between product browsing and purchase.
remediationChecklist: Name variant options and expose selected values
Announce additions to product comparison
verificationScenario: Compare two products and switch to a different variant from the detail page. Verify that variation labels convey changes to availability and that compare state persists through navigation.

name: WooCommerce Stores
riskContext: Checkout extensions and theme overrides often change accessible form semantics.
commonFailures: Guest checkout errors detached from inputs
remediationChecklist: Test checkout validation for guest orders
Implement keyboard-operable product tabs
verificationScenario: Add a product, select a shipping option and submit a guest checkout with an invalid postal code. Confirm the postal code error is linked to its input and other checkout values remain.

name: Squarespace Sites
riskContext: Template blocks and custom embeds can undo accessible editorial structure.
remediationChecklist: Use heading blocks according to section hierarchy
Measure hero text contrast across breakpoints
verificationScenario: Inspect the heading outline of a services page after switching templates. Check that every service remains under a meaningful heading and verify text contrast at mobile and desktop hero crops.

name: Wix Sites
riskContext: Widget configuration can affect accessibility of service and contact paths.
remediationChecklist: Give social links accessible names
Test focus order from service selection through booking
verificationScenario: Book a sample service from a Wix widget using keyboard navigation. Confirm you can choose a date, navigate back to earlier steps and return to the booking trigger when dismissing the widget.

name: Webflow Sites
riskContext: Custom interactions can hide content or controls from keyboard users.
remediationChecklist: Expose disclosures through native controls
Connect each modal title and verify focus restoration
verificationScenario: Open a menu disclosure and a gated-download dialog from a Webflow page. Check escape and close behavior, dialog naming and whether the original trigger receives focus at dismissal.

name: Drupal Sites
riskContext: Editorial workflows can introduce barriers in regularly updated institutional content.
remediationChecklist: Require editorial review of meaningful image alternatives
Label views filters and verify their status messages
verificationScenario: Publish a new Drupal content item with meaningful imagery, then find it through a filtered view. Check the published alternative text, result-count announcement and active filter state.

name: Adobe Commerce Stores
riskContext: Custom catalog and checkout modules can affect many store views at once.
remediationChecklist: Add scoped headers to comparisons
Group shipping methods under a legend
verificationScenario: Compare catalog items and complete the shipping-method step of a test checkout. Check row and column relationships with a screen reader and confirm shipping labels include cost and delivery timing.

name: BigCommerce Stores
riskContext: Storefront customizations can create barriers on shared product templates.
remediationChecklist: Name quick-view buttons with product context
Provide a pause control for moving recommendations
verificationScenario: Open quick view from several items and dismiss it with the keyboard. Verify each trigger identifies its item and confirm the storefront can be explored while recommendations are paused.

name: PrestaShop Stores
riskContext: Module-driven product and cart flows can create inconsistent interaction behavior.
remediationChecklist: Announce discount totals
Return focus to the filter toggle after closing the panel
verificationScenario: Apply a combination of facets and remove a coupon from a test cart. Check that focus returns to the filter toggle and that discount removal announces the updated total.

name: Headless Commerce
riskContext: A custom frontend must preserve access through asynchronous product and payment interactions.
remediationChecklist: Move focus meaningfully on navigation
Name payment frames and test embedded payment controls
verificationScenario: Navigate between product, cart and checkout views. Confirm the keyboard and screen reader location remains meaningful after route changes and the payment fields work inside their embedded frame.

name: Membership Associations
riskContext: Inaccessible applications or renewals can exclude prospective or existing members.
remediationChecklist: Use a headed dues table
Provide accessible timeout notification and extension
verificationScenario: Compare membership tiers and renew one on a test account. Verify the dues table reads correctly by row and that extending the renewal session preserves the entered information.

name: Employment & Recruiting Portals
riskContext: Application friction can prevent disabled candidates from participating in hiring.
commonFailures: Screening forms that reject keyboard input
remediationChecklist: Name the upload control and describe constraints
Complete a screening workflow with keyboard only
verificationScenario: Complete a test job application with a valid resume and an invalid upload. Check that the upload status is announced and applicants can navigate screening questions in logical order.

name: Veterinary Clinics
riskContext: Clients need usable access to urgent-care instructions and bookings.
commonFailures: Client intake forms built as scans
remediationChecklist: Publish and label emergency contact actions
Convert intake forms to accessible fields
verificationScenario: Find emergency hours and start the new-client appointment workflow. Verify the emergency phone link is descriptive and intake fields remain readable at 200% text zoom.

name: Local News Publishers
riskContext: Readers may be blocked from articles or subscriptions by inaccessible paywalls.
remediationChecklist: Manage paywall focus and name its close control
Provide text summaries for informative graphics
verificationScenario: Open a subscription prompt, dismiss it and continue reading. Confirm that focus returns to the article and that complex charts provide a text description or accessible data behind the graphic.

name: Online Donation Platforms
riskContext: Donors can be unable to select giving frequency or recover from payment problems.
commonFailures: Card errors that only use color
remediationChecklist: Expose recurring gift state
Associate readable payment errors with their inputs
verificationScenario: Choose a recurring donation, switch to a single gift and trigger a test payment error. Verify the selected frequency, total and recovery instructions are announced and focus remains useful.

name: Telehealth Platforms
riskContext: Remote patients may be unable to join or use virtual care workflows.
remediationChecklist: Test join and permission steps by keyboard
Announce meaningful waiting room changes
verificationScenario: Join a mock visit with microphone permission denied. Ensure permission controls work by keyboard and that waiting status and available alternatives are conveyed to assistive technology.

name: Election Information Portals
riskContext: Public voting information and registration tools can fall within Title II coverage.
commonFailures: Polling place maps without addresses in text
remediationChecklist: Publish polling locations in an accessible list
Check ballot document reading order and accessible alternatives
verificationScenario: Find a polling location by address and open the sample ballot with a screen reader. Confirm that the text lists location access information and each ballot contest reads in the appropriate sequence.
